## Purpose

This module is the SQLAlchemy persistence layer: 22 ORM model files plus [database.py](../../backend/app/models/database.py)
(engine/session/`Base`) and [schemas.py](../../backend/app/models/schemas.py) (Pydantic API request/response models, not ORM).

[__init__.py](../../backend/app/models/__init__.py) is the single import point that forces every model onto `Base.metadata` (required
for Alembic autogenerate/check) and re-exports the ORM classes and schemas consumed throughout
`app/api`, `app/agents`, the execution engine, and `app/scripts`.

## Shape

The core run lineage is `User` (`users`) → `WorkflowRun` (`workflow_runs`, self-referential via
`parent_run_id` for revisions) → `ChatSession`/`Message` (`chat_sessions`/`messages`) for the
free-chat surface, and `WorkflowClarification` (`workflow_clarifications`) for per-run Q&A.

A saved/DB-authored workflow DAG lives in `WorkflowDefinition` (table `workflows`), separate
from the per-user `WorkflowMemory` (`workflow_memory`) key/value constitution store.

`RevokedToken` (`revoked_tokens`) is an independent auth-only table keyed by JWT `jti`, with
`user_id` denormalized on for cheap per-user queries and lazily GC'd by
`cleanup_expired_revocations`.

Everything else is Phase-5-onward "typed artifact / runtime" persistence, **uniformly
owner+workspace scoped** (`owner_id` + `workspace_id`, REQ-AUTHZ-01) so the `ScopedStore`
default-deny filter applies the same way to every table:

- `Workspace` (`workspaces`) — one row per sandbox/runtime; `workspace_id` is set equal to its
  own `id` so the scope filter holds for workspace reads too. `repo_id` links to `Repository`
  (`repositories`, Phase 9) for repo-bound runs.
- `ArtifactRef` (`artifact_refs`) — the sole persisted artifact model (replaced the deleted
  `WorkflowArtifact`/`workflow_artifacts` thin store in migration 0015); content is stored
  inline, versioned per `(run_id, kind)`, with `derived_from` self-FK for lineage.
- `RunEvent` (`run_events`, append-only) + `DeepLinkNonce` (`deep_link_nonces`) — the durable
  event log and single-use deep-link nonce store, both added in [run_event.py](../../backend/app/models/run_event.py).
- `RunCapabilities` (`run_capabilities`) — one row per run's capability/runtime snapshot.
- Per-subsystem audit rows, each one row per firing/invocation: `ValidationResult`
  (`validation_results`), `GateEvent` (`gate_events`), `HookRun` (`hook_runs`), `ExecRun`
  (`exec_runs`), `SubagentRun` (`subagent_runs`, fan-out children), `WaveRun` (`wave_runs`,
  fan-out waves).
- `McpCredential` (`mcp_credentials`) and the [handoff.py](../../backend/app/models/handoff.py) trio — `UserGithubCredential`
  (`user_github_credentials`), `UserApiKey` (`user_api_keys`), `HandoffSession`
  (`handoff_sessions`) — hold owner-scoped, Fernet-encrypted secrets, never plaintext.

Every table added past [handoff.py](../../backend/app/models/handoff.py) in the file list — i.e. everything above
`workflow_runs`/`workflows`/`chat_sessions` — was added as an **additive-only migration**
(`backend/alembic/versions/0014`–`0030`): each model file's docstring names its originating
migration (e.g. [exec_runs.py](../../backend/app/models/exec_runs.py) → 0018, [subagent_run.py](../../backend/app/models/subagent_run.py) → 0019, [wave_run.py](../../backend/app/models/wave_run.py) → 0020,
`deep_link_nonces` → 0025).

`WorkflowRun` itself shows the pattern most clearly: `owner_id`/`workspace_id` (0014),
`deliverable_mimetype`/`deliverable_filename` (0022), `selections_json` (0023),
`od_context_json` (0027) were all bolted on as nullable columns after the fact rather than
altering existing ones — the one destructive exception on record is migration 0013, which
dropped the redundant `pipeline_run_id` column once `WorkflowRun.id` became the sole run
identifier.

## Why this shape

Audit/event tables (`exec_runs`, `gate_events`, `hook_runs`, `validation_results`,
`subagent_runs`, `wave_runs`) are kept as separate one-row-per-firing tables rather than columns
on `workflow_runs` because they are append-only, multiplicity-many-per-run, and each is written
by a distinct subsystem (exec sandboxing, gates, hooks, validators, fan-out) that shouldn't
contend on the run row.

They deliberately repeat the same `id`/`run_id` FK/`owner_id`/`workspace_id`/`created_at` shape
(explicitly called out in each docstring as mirroring an earlier precedent table) so the
`ScopedStore` default-deny scoping logic is uniform and new audit tables can be added without
touching existing ones.

Outcome/status columns (`outcome`, `status`, `isolation`, `provider`, `server`) are consistently
free `String` rather than `sa.Enum` — **every docstring notes this is deliberate**, to keep
additive migrations reversible without an enum-alteration step.

Secrets (`UserGithubCredential.encrypted_pat`, `McpCredential.encrypted_secret`) are isolated in
their own owner-scoped tables rather than denormalized onto `User`, both to keep the encrypted
blob's lifecycle independent (a rotation or revoke is a single-table operation) and to keep
`users` free of sensitive payloads.

`ArtifactRef` replacing `WorkflowArtifact` (0015, after 0014 introduced it) shows the same
additive discipline applied to a full cutover: the old table was only dropped once the new
one's read path had parity, not as part of introducing it.
